name: Full Volume Indie Rock (Sunnyvale)
instructions: Groover: 'If your track has that energetic, hooky indie sound, send it over. Tracks approved will be added ... on the Top 20 for at least one week.' Spotify desc only says 'Contact: sunnyvaleplaylists@gmail.com'.
notes: Independent curator, listed under Netherlands on Groover. Upbeat indie rock / garage / alt rock, updated every Monday. Email is a general contact, not an explicit submission invite. Same account's other lists (techno/EDM) have <10 saves - check stats before paying.

name: Edge Of Indie (HQindie)
instructions: "Do you want to be added to our Spotify playlists? Feel free to submit your music for review. Please use the links below." (link = Groover). Groover profile: "We can add your music to one (or more) of our Spotify playlists."
notes: Curator: HQindie (Bergen promo/management team, artists themselves). Focus indie pop, indie rock, indie folk, singer-songwriter; Groover genres accepted most often: alternative rock, indie rock. Not restricted to Nordic acts on Groover (recent adds: Elephant, Peter Stone, Jonathan Kotik). info@hqindie.com is the general contact; the page points submissions to Groover. Also on SubmitHub (reportedly premium-only).

notes: Curator: Broken Palace. Indie-alt / dreampop / shoegaze. Groover only (paid).

name: Weekly5 • 2026 (Negative White)
instructions: 'If you are a musician, label, or promoter and want to send your latest stuff, please use the following email: promotion[ät]negativewhite.com | Songs for Weekly5 have to be submitted on Fridays before 2 pm CET.'
notes: Curator: Janosch. Swiss indie magazine; five new songs every Sunday, latest edition 2026-11-08. Tiny playlist but free and active.

name: i'M ON THE ROAD (iMusician)
instructions: 'Fill out the form below and pitch your road trip track to our curators.'
notes: Curator: iMusician (Swiss distributor). Road-trip rock/indie. Free form.

name: New Indie Music (roesmusic)
instructions: Groover: 'A sucker for a great Indie song, whether it's Pop, Folk, Rock... Tracks approved will be added to the playlist New Indie Music on the Top 23.' Spotify desc: 'Contact: roesmusic2001@gmail.com'.
notes: Listed under Netherlands on Groover. Leans uplifting indie pop/folk (Djo, Parcels, Tame Impala); open to garage rock. Email is general contact only.

name: Surf Rock / Surf Pop / Indie Surf (For The Love Of Bands)
instructions: 'submit music to our Spotify playlists for free by using the regular option 4'; paid/merch/engagement options skip the queue.
notes: Curator: Roel (FTLOB). Surfy indie rock, garage pop, psych, jangly guitars. Same curator as the existing Indie Radar / New Rock rows.

name: Rebel Anthems: New Punk Rock, Pop Punk and Emo (For The Love Of Bands)
instructions: 'submit music to our Spotify playlists for free by using the regular option 4'; paid/merch/engagement options skip the queue.
notes: Curator: Roel (FTLOB). Punk / pop punk / emo, 2026. Same curator as the existing Indie Radar / New Rock rows.

name: Highclouds: Forecast Tape (HighClouds)
instructions: 'If you wanna send us a video or a track, please use SubmitHub.' Links needed before release; answer within 70 hours; '$1 to submit'.
notes: Curator: Attila. Brussels blog, weekly playlist; leans ethereal/left-of-centre pop and indie, so rock is a stretch. Feeds 'Best Songs of 2026' (2,296 saves).

name: Songs of the Week 2026 - Spotify (Le Village Pop)
instructions: Site 'Submission Platform: Groover' page: 'Send us your track through Groover, get listened to and feedback guaranteed!'
notes: French webradio; pop/folk/rock/psych, weekly picks, active 2026. Spotify twin of the existing Deezer row. Small save count but also radio airplay.

name: Playlist Découvertes (Sound of Brit)
instructions: Groover: 'We share all things related to British music (rock)... 2. Add the artist to our monthly discovery playlist.' Contact page lists email but says nothing about submissions.
notes: Curator: Augustin (writer of #24, Oct 2026). French webzine on British rock - strong genre fit. New Spotify playlist per edition (Découvertes #24, 2 saves), so value is the article + social reach (20k), not streams.

name: Melancholic Indie (HQindie)
instructions: "Do you want to be added to our Spotify playlists? Feel free to submit your music for review. Please use the links below." (link = Groover)
notes: Curator: HQindie. Moody/melancholic indie; fits slower or darker FloodLines tracks. Same Groover pitch covers all HQindie playlists.

name: For the days you feel lost (Frode Møller)
instructions: "I accept ONLY released tracks. No songs with swearing. Indie pop/rock for when you feel lost or alone. Inspiring music when we are feeling a bit sad." No pure AI songs.
notes: Curator: Frode. Groover genres accepted most often: alternative rock, hard rock, indie rock, pop rock. No swearing in lyrics; released tracks only. His other playlists are small/generic (gym, best-ofs), so pitch for this one.

name: Päivän Biisit (All That Plazz)
instructions: "We get hundreads of lovely submissions every week, best way to get playlisted is by using Submithub. Send us your music on SubmitHub"
notes: Curator: Aleksi (Pahkala). Daily new-music playlist and blog since 2018, genre-free, but Groover lists alternative rock, indie rock, post punk and punk rock as most often accepted. Also on Groover (groover.co/en/influencer/profile/0.paivan-biisit/). Run by a Helsinki label/PR company. The email is the label's general contact, not a submission route. SubmitHub free/premium not checked, so paid is set true to be safe.

name: Heavy on the Road (Shaya)
instructions: Playlist description: 'submit here sbmt.to/shaya'.
notes: Curator: Shaya. Heavier road rock; also Groover 0.shaya. Mood playlist curator, mixed genres overall.

name: Punk Rock & Pop (Colorful Playlists)
instructions: Groover profile: 'Psychedelic Rock, Alternative Rock, Indie Rock, Modern Rock. No Covers! We prefer english vocals. NO AI MUSIC!'
notes: Curator: Fabian. Punk/pop-punk; weaker fit. Groover only (paid).

name: Indie-Charts Release Radar (Austrian Indie Charts)
instructions: Playlist description: 'Immer die neueste Indie-Musik aus Österreich und der Welt. Info und Kontakt: office@indiecharts.at' (contact, not an explicit submission invite).
notes: Curator: Andreas. Austrian indie charts; includes UK acts (Jamie T, Lambrini Girls). Small.

name: dreampop paradise - Dream Pop / Shoegaze / Surf Pop (For The Love Of Bands)
instructions: 'submit music to our Spotify playlists for free by using the regular option 4'; paid/merch/engagement options skip the queue.
notes: Curator: Roel (FTLOB). Dream pop, shoegaze, bedroom pop - only if the track is dreamy. Same curator as the existing Indie Radar / New Rock rows.

name: Disco Naïveté New Music (Disco Naïveté)
instructions: Groover: 'Approved songs will be added to my Spotify playlist which is updated every week (on Friday)... diverse genres... playlisted for about 3 weeks.'
notes: Listed under Belgium on Groover; also on SubmitHub. Weekly, multi-genre leaning electronic/indie pop; (very) selective. Rock not a focus.

name: Penguin Pool (Pinguin Radio)
instructions: Playlist desc: 'The best music from www.musisum.com'. Pinguin site 'Airplay?' links to Musisum ('Support upcoming artists'); sign up free at musisum.com/join.
notes: Dutch indie radio. Fed from Musisum (Pinguin's artist platform); pricing for airplay/playlist not shown, so paid status unconfirmed. Radar playlist already in list.

name: Nordic Indie Pop (HQindie)
instructions: "Do you want to be added to our Spotify playlists? Feel free to submit your music for review. Please use the links below." (link = Groover)
notes: Curator: HQindie. The biggest HQindie list, but the name and focus are Nordic acts (indie pop/rock/folk), so likely Nordic-only. Pitch through the same Groover submission as Edge Of Indie.

name: TOPP 30 (Zero Music Magazine)
instructions: "Zero Music Magazine doesn't accept email submissions anymore... If you'd like us to listen to your song, please send it via SubmitHub."
notes: Curator: Jon Josefsson (editor). Swedish alt music magazine online since 1994. Weekly chart (V46 when fetched, so active). Leans synthpop/electropop, so a weak match for guitar indie. SubmitHub free/premium not checked.

name: OCTA New Music Weekly (One Chord To Another)
instructions: "If you want to be on the playlist, send the submission on the release week... add something like Onechord or OCTA in the subject line... There's no point in sending me metal or hip-hop... if do you have some good new folk, country, power pop, indie pop, americana... then I'm all ears."
notes: Finnish hobby blog. Weekly playlist, episode #393 on 8 Nov 2026, so very active. Covers country, americana, folk, power pop and indie pop, so only melodic/jangly FloodLines songs suit it. Send in release week with OCTA in the subject line.
